subject: Helixion: VP nomination for compressed demo window and runbook
messages:
From: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@helixion.com>
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
Cc: procurement@helixion.com
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Scheduling - demo with CTO/VP presence

Hi Rachel,

Thanks for the quick turnaround on the earlier threads. We have a tighter window than expected on June 2 — our execs will only be available 30 minutes between 10:30–11:00 PT. That slot is the only one where both our VP of Engineering (Sara Kim) and CTO (Daniel Cho) can join.

Two asks: can Redwood nominate who will join at VP level (we usually prefer VP/GM > demo lead) and can you provide a short runbook/agenda tailored to a compressed 30-minute exec walkthrough + 10 minutes Q&A? We want to make sure the session is crisp and that any technical deep-dive can be handed off if needed.

Appreciate if you loop procurement as well so they can start a timeline for contract redlines while we lock the demo.

Best,
Ashwin
Ashwin Rao
Head of Platform Partnerships, Helixion
ashwin@helixion.com
+1 (415) 555-0198

--
Attachment: (none)
From: rachel_kim@redwood.ai
To: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@helixion.com>
Cc: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai, procurement@helixion.com
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 10:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixion: VP nomination for compressed demo window and runbook

Hi Ashwin — thanks for the note and context. We can absolutely run a tight, exec-focused 30-minute session on June 2 10:30–11:00 PT. Cooking up a short runbook now.

Quick answers up front:
- VP nomination: Ben Carter (VP, Solutions) will be the primary exec-level attendee and lead the customer-facing portion; I will also join as the engagement sponsor to handle next-steps and procurement handoffs.
- Runbook/agenda: attached is a two-slide agenda + a one-page runbook that maps timeboxes and owners. The goal is: 15 min value narrative + 10 min targeted tech highlight (KV cache / latency economics) + 5 min Q&A 

Ben/Neha — can you confirm Ben can take the VP slot on 6/2 10:30–11:00 PT? If Ben is out, who can step in at VP level? If we need a deeper engineering dive, Neha can join the tech segment.

Ashwin — procurement included; Ben and I will follow up with a contract timeline after the demo. If the execs prefer a separate technical deep-dive, we can schedule a follow-up technical workshop (30–45m) with Neha and our infra lead.

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Director, Strategic Accounts | Redwood Inference
rachel_kim@redwood.ai
+1 (628) 555-0322

Attachments: Helixion_demo_agenda_v1.pdf; redwood-runbook-brief.pptx
From: neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
To: rachel_kim@redwood.ai, ben_carter@redwood.ai
Cc: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@helixion.com>
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 12:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixion: VP nomination for compressed demo window and runbook

Rachel / Ben — I can take the deep-dive portion if needed. Ben — if you can run the top-level narrative that’d be ideal; I’ll own the 10-min tech highlight and have a one-slide backup on KV-cache perf comparisons and a small latency/cost slide (numbers tuned to Helixion's expected 2k TPS demo).

If Ben is available, confirm here and I’ll prep the tech notes + a single appendix slide with follow-ups and handoff owners.

Also thinking: because the window is so short, we should enable a post-demo follow-up slot for procurement + legal to triage vendor questions — suggest Tue or Wed afternoon that week. Ashwin — is procurement good with receiving our timeline in the next 24 hours?

-neha
Neha Kapoor
Sr. Solutions Architect, Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
From: ben_carter@redwood.ai
To: Ashwin Rao <ashwin@helixion.com>, rachel_kim@redwood.ai, neha_kapoor@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 23 May 2028 17:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Helixion: VP nomination for compressed demo window and runbook

Ashwin — confirmed. I’ll take the VP slot on June 2 10:30–11:00 PT. Plan: 15m strategic narrative + 10m technical highlight (Neha) + 5m next steps & procurement triage.

Rachel — please send the calendar invite with the attached agenda and runbook; put me as organizer so my calendar handles the VP-level reminders. Neha — thank you, I’ll coordinate any appendix material you need.

Ashwin / procurement — looking forward to seeing your invite accepted. If the execs prefer any pre-read, we can supply a 2-page exec brief that morning.

-Ben
Ben Carter
VP, Solutions | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0172
